dialogue.content: むたさん、こんばんは。今日はよろしくお願いします。時間になりましたら始めさせていただきますね
dialogue.English: Good evening, Muta-san. Thank you for coming today. We'll begin at our scheduled time.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: すみませんギリギリになりました
dialogue.English: I'm sorry for cutting it so close.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です始めさせていただきますね
dialogue.English: That's alright. Let's get started.

dialogue.content: お願い致します
dialogue.English: Please do.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。差し支えなければ、年齢と性別をおしえていただけますか
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor. If you don't mind, could you tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 22歳　女性です
dialogue.English: I'm a 22-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださりありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 辛かったり悲しかったりどうしようもなくて何もしたくないんです
dialogue.English: I feel so pained, sad, and helpless that I don't want to do anything.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。そんな状態が続いてるのは、お辛いですね・・
dialogue.English: I see. It must be very hard to feel that way for so long.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いつ頃からなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: About how long have you been feeling this way?

dialogue.content: 特にここ１ヶ月くらいです
dialogue.English: Especially in the last month or so.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですか・・ずっと何もしたくなくて・・しんどかったですねどんなことがあったのかお聴きしても大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see... Not wanting to do anything for so long... that must have been very hard. Would it be alright if I asked what happened?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ３ヶ月前に父が亡くなりました
dialogue.English: My father passed away three months ago.

dialogue.content: そんな悲しいことが・・本当にお辛かったですね・・
dialogue.English: Such a sad thing to happen... That must have been incredibly painful for you.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: お父様とは最後にお話しとかはできましたか？
dialogue.English: Were you able to speak with your father at the end?

dialogue.content: 最後看取ることはできました朦朧としてる中ですが、少し話せました
dialogue.English: I was able to be with him at the end. He was in and out of consciousness, but we were able to talk a little.

dialogue.content: 思い出すだけで本当につらくて…
dialogue.English: Just remembering it is really painful...

dialogue.content: でも思い出しちゃって
dialogue.English: But I can't help but remember.

dialogue.content: 最後本当に苦しそうで…
dialogue.English: He looked like he was in so much pain at the end...

dialogue.content: 心電図のピーって鳴り響く音が頭が今でも聞こえてきます…
dialogue.English: I can still hear the piercing beep of the heart monitor in my head...

dialogue.content: 頭から離れず
dialogue.English: I can't get it out of my head.

dialogue.content: 父自身涙を流しながらこの世をさりました
dialogue.English: My father himself passed away with tears streaming down his face.

dialogue.content: そうだったんすね・・本当にお辛い経験をされたんですねお父様の苦しんでいる姿が目に焼き付いていたり、その時の状況が昨日のように感じられて、
dialogue.English: I see... You went through a truly painful experience. The image of your father suffering is burned into your mind, and the situation feels like it was just yesterday,

dialogue.content: 苦しいですよね・・
dialogue.English: It must be agonizing...

dialogue.content: 苦しいです…
dialogue.English: It is agonizing...

dialogue.content: パパっ子で大好きだったんです
dialogue.English: I was a daddy's girl and I loved him so much.

dialogue.content: お父様のことが大好きだったのに・・今一緒にいないと思うと、とても寂しいですよね・・
dialogue.English: You loved your father so much... It must feel so lonely to think that he's not with you now.

dialogue.content: 信じられないです
dialogue.English: I can't believe it.

dialogue.content: 信じたくないです
dialogue.English: I don't want to believe it.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・現実だなんて思いたくないですよね
dialogue.English: I understand... You don't want to think that this is real.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: No, I don't.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、今はご家族とお住まいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: By the way, are you currently living with your family?

dialogue.content: 一人暮らしです
dialogue.English: I live alone.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですねなおさら、寂しいお気持ちになってしまいますね
dialogue.English: I see. That must make the loneliness feel even stronger.

dialogue.content: はい夜になると思いだして寂しすぎて過呼吸のようになることがあります
dialogue.English: Yes. At night, I remember, and I feel so lonely that I sometimes start to hyperventilate.

dialogue.content: 思い出しただけで、そんなにも苦しくなってしまって・・悲しいお気持ちが伝わってきます。お父様とは最後にどんなことをはなされたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Just remembering makes it that painful... I can feel how deep your sadness is. If it's not too difficult, could you share what you and your father talked about at the end?

dialogue.content: すみません…ちょっとつらくて
dialogue.English: I'm sorry... it's a bit too hard right now.

dialogue.content: ごめんなさいねお辛いのにお聴きしてしまって・・
dialogue.English: I'm so sorry. I shouldn't have asked when it's so painful for you.

dialogue.content: ずっとこのままだとどうにかなってしまいそうで…この気持ちどうしたらいいんでしょうか…もう、つらくてわからないです
dialogue.English: I feel like if this goes on I might fall apart... What should I do with these feelings? I'm so overwhelmed I don't know anymore.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・辛いときには思い切り泣いたりしてますか？
dialogue.English: I see... When you feel sad, do you let yourself cry it all out?

dialogue.content: はい、泣き叫ぶくらい…
dialogue.English: Yes, to the point of screaming...

dialogue.content: でも泣いても父は戻ってこないし色んな思い出思い出すしつらくてつらくて
dialogue.English: But even if I cry, my father won't come back, and I just remember all these things, and it's so, so painful.

dialogue.content: 苦しい
dialogue.English: It's agonizing.

dialogue.content: どうしたらこの気持ちから解放されますか…
dialogue.English: How can I be freed from these feelings...?

dialogue.content: 泣いて涙を流すことで浄化作用があるといわれてますが・・苦しいというお気持ちになってしまうんですね
dialogue.English: They say that crying and shedding tears can have a cleansing effect... but for you, it just makes you feel more pain.

dialogue.content: ぜひこの辛さが少しでも和らぐように、一緒に考えていきたいと思いますが、いかがでしょうか
dialogue.English: I would really like to think together with you about how we can ease this pain, even just a little. Would that be okay?

dialogue.content: 父に会いたいのにいない会えない話せないつらい苦しいです
dialogue.English: I want to see my father, but he's not here; I can't see him, I can't talk to him. It's painful and agonizing.

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 考えるにあたり、いくつかお聴きしても大丈夫でしょうか
dialogue.English: To think this through together, may I ask you a few questions?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お父様は、どんな方だったんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What kind of person was your father?

dialogue.content: あまりしゃべる方ではないけど優しくてシャイで家族思いで大好きでした
dialogue.English: He wasn't very talkative, but he was kind, shy, and devoted to his family. I loved him so much.

dialogue.content: 会いたい…
dialogue.English: I want to see him...

dialogue.content: つらい
dialogue.English: It's painful.

dialogue.content: 亡くなったかたのことを思い出して語るのも、供養になると言われます
dialogue.English: They say that remembering and talking about the person who has passed away is also a way to honor their memory.

dialogue.content: でも、つらいです
dialogue.English: But it's painful.

dialogue.content: 話しても戻ってこない…
dialogue.English: Talking about him won't bring him back...

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・確かに戻ってこないと思うと、どんなにお辛いか・・
dialogue.English: You're right... To think that he won't come back, I can only imagine how painful that must be.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: つらすぎる…
dialogue.English: It's too painful...

dialogue.content: でも、悲しい気持ちに蓋をして我慢しているといつかコプから水があふれてこぼれだしてしまうように・・
dialogue.English: But if you keep bottling up your sad feelings and holding them in, it's like water eventually overflowing from a cup...

dialogue.content: 誤字ごめんなさいねコップです
dialogue.English: I'm sorry for the typo, I meant cup.

dialogue.content: あなたのことがとても心配です
dialogue.English: I'm very worried about you.

dialogue.content: 辛いお気持ちをどんどん吐き出してほしいのです
dialogue.English: I want you to pour out your painful feelings.

dialogue.content: 今はまだつらすぎて無理かもしれないです
dialogue.English: Right now it might still be too painful; I may not be able to.

dialogue.content: 現実と向き合えないです
dialogue.English: I can't face reality.

dialogue.content: ダメですか
dialogue.English: Is that bad?

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・お辛いことを思い出させてしまいましたね
dialogue.English: I see... I've made you remember painful things.

dialogue.content: まだ信じられないお気持ちなのに・・どうしていいかわからなくても無理もないですよね
dialogue.English: You still can't believe it... It's only natural that you don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: はいこれでも少しずつ向き合おうとしてます…
dialogue.English: Yes... Even so, I'm trying to face it, little by little.

dialogue.content: はじめは、嘘だと思い込んで思い出さずに仕事にしか意識を向けないようにしてました
dialogue.English: At first, I convinced myself it was a lie and tried not to remember, focusing only on my work.

dialogue.content: けど、家族も落ち込んでて徐々に現実になってきて
dialogue.English: But my family was also grieving, and it gradually started to feel real.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・ずっと思い出さずに心に蓋をして悲しみを閉じ込めて過ごしていたんですね・・お父様はあなたにとってかけがえのない存在だったんですものね
dialogue.English: I see... So you spent all this time trying not to remember, bottling up your sadness inside... Your father was an irreplaceable person in your life, wasn't he?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お父様がいないという現実を受け入れるのは、時間もかかるのは当然だと思います。
dialogue.English: I think it's natural that it will take time to accept the reality that your father is gone.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいでしょうか
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: 他のことに気を紛らわしてもやはり悲しみから逃れるのは、並大抵のことではないですよね・・
dialogue.English: Even if you try to distract yourself with other things, escaping from this sorrow is no easy task, is it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: No, it's not.

dialogue.content: 今までのお話を伺って、お父様のことを思い出して過呼吸になってしまうほど辛くて苦しくて寂しいというお気持ち
dialogue.English: From what you've told me so far, I can feel your pain, agony, and loneliness, so much so that you hyperventilate when you remember your father.

dialogue.content: とても伝わってきました。
dialogue.English: I can really feel that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お父様の好きだったものとか、好きだった食べ物とかあったら教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me about some of the things your father liked, or his favorite foods?

dialogue.content: 甘いものが好きでした
dialogue.English: He liked sweets.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね甘いもの？例えばどんなもの？特に好きだったもの教えてもらえますか
dialogue.English: I see, sweet things? For example, what kind? Could you tell me what he especially liked?

dialogue.content: ジャンボポップコーンをよく食べてました
dialogue.English: He often ate jumbo popcorn.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・あなたも一緒に食べたりとかはしてましたか？
dialogue.English: I see... Did you eat it with him sometimes?

dialogue.content: たまに
dialogue.English: Sometimes.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・お話を伺って感じたことをお伝えしてもよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.English: I understand... May I share what I'm sensing from what you've told me?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたはお父様のことを思い出すと辛いので仕事に熱中して忘れようとしていたけれど、やっぱり思い出してしまい、
dialogue.English: You tried to forget about your father by immersing yourself in work because it's painful to remember him, but you still end up remembering,

dialogue.content: とてもお辛い毎日を送っていますでもお父様はあなたの悲しむ姿をどこか空の上からとか、時には風になって見ていると思います
dialogue.English: and you're living each day in great pain. But I believe your father is watching over your grieving self from somewhere up in the sky, or perhaps as the wind at times.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 辛いかもしれませんが、あなたの悲しみに蓋をして生きていても、いつか溢れてしまうのでは？と思います
dialogue.English: It may be painful, but I think that if you continue to live while bottling up your sadness, it might overflow someday.

dialogue.content: そうですか
dialogue.English: You think so?

dialogue.content: 悲しい気持ちを我慢し続けるとさらにもっと悲しい気持ちが深くなってしまうのでは？と思うのですが、どう思われますか？
dialogue.English: I feel that if you continue to hold back your sad feelings, that sadness might become even deeper. What do you think?

dialogue.content: 我慢…
dialogue.English: Holding back...

dialogue.content: 悲しみを我慢しているわけではないです悲しいからこそ苦しくて
dialogue.English: I'm not holding back my sadness. It's because I'm sad that it's so agonizing.

dialogue.content: だからちょっとわからないです
dialogue.English: So I don't really understand.

dialogue.content: うまくお伝えできなくてごめんなさいね何が言いたいかいうと、悲しいときには思い切り泣いたり、お父様のことを思い出していいんですよ
dialogue.English: I'm sorry I didn't express that well. What I mean is, when you're sad, it's okay to cry your heart out and to remember your father.

dialogue.content: なるほど苦しくてもつらくてもそうしたほうがいいんですね
dialogue.English: I see. So it's better to do that, even if it's agonizing and painful.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: しばらくはつらさや苦しさは耐えないとならないんですね…
dialogue.English: So I'll have to endure the pain and agony for a while...

dialogue.content: 頑張ってみます
dialogue.English: I'll try my best.

dialogue.content: 今日は話を聞いていただいてありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for listening to me today.

dialogue.content: お話を伺って、思い出したら苦しいから思い出を話したくないって言われていたので・・
dialogue.English: From what I heard, you said you didn't want to talk about memories because it's too painful to remember...

dialogue.content: できたら。お父様の好きだったジャンボポップコーンを食べながら、思い出などむいぐるみとかがあれば、お話したりして
dialogue.English: If you can, maybe you could eat your father's favorite jumbo popcorn and talk about your memories to a stuffed animal, if you have one,

dialogue.content: お辛いかもしれませんが、
dialogue.English: It may be painful, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: お父様がきっとどこかであなたのことを、見守ってくれていると思います。
dialogue.English: I'm sure your father is watching over you from somewhere.

dialogue.content: そうだといいです
dialogue.English: I hope so.

dialogue.content: そんな気持ちで過ごされたら、と思います
dialogue.English: I hope you can go about your days with that feeling.

dialogue.content: はい、そうしてみます
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll try to do that.

dialogue.content: あまり無理をされずに、お父様が好きだった食べ物など食べて、一緒に食べているようなお気持ちになれたら、と思っています
dialogue.English: Please don't push yourself too hard. I hope that by eating the foods your father liked, you can feel as if you're eating together with him.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたの笑顔が取り戻せる日が必ず来ると信じています
dialogue.English: I believe a day will surely come when you can get your smile back.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: お父様が食べたかった甘いものを代わりにたくさん食べて、あなたも元気になってくださいね
dialogue.English: Please eat lots of the sweets your father would have wanted to eat, and let them help you regain your strength.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: お父様もきっと喜んでくれると思いますよ
dialogue.English: I'm sure your father would be happy, too.

dialogue.content: 今日はお辛い中大事なお話を聴かせてくださりありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing such important things with me today, even though it was painful.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました
dialogue.English: No, thank you.

dialogue.content: きょうは辛いお話を聴いてしまい、お疲れになったかと思います。暖かいお風呂にゆっくりつかってお休みくださいね
dialogue.English: You must be tired after talking about such painful things today. Please take a long, warm bath and get some rest.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I will.

dialogue.content: ほんとうによくお越しくださいました。こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you so much for coming today. No, thank *you*.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございましたそれでは、失礼します
dialogue.English: Thank you. Well then, I'll be going now.

dialogue.content: はいでは終了させて頂きますね。
dialogue.English: Okay, I will end the session now.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: （ロープレお疲れさまでした　ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the role-play.)

dialogue.content: （むたさん、遅い時間まで大変ありがとうございました。とても勉強になりました））
dialogue.English: (Muta-san, thank you so much for staying so late. It was a great learning experience.)

dialogue.content: （終了ボタン押させていただきますね）
dialogue.English: (I'll go ahead and press the end button.)
